findings.claim: The artifact reader discards official A2UI DataParts before the official extractor can read them.
findings.evidence: readArtifact filters candidates using candidate.mediaType === PROMETHEUS_A2UI_MEDIA_TYPE before calling extractA2UIMessages. UPG-9 explicitly specifies official DataParts with metadata.mimeType set to application/a2ui+json and data containing the message list. Those parts do not pass this top-level mediaType filter, so a2uiParts is empty and readArtifact returns null, preventing the migrated example from rendering its agent artifact as required by UPG-14.
findings.suggested_fix: Deserialize the artifact's parts and let extractA2UIMessages identify official A2UI parts, or filter using the official metadata.mimeType location.

findings.claim: The migrated golden fixture no longer matches the producer output it is intended to replay.
findings.evidence: createTaskBoardSurfaceMessages in src/agent/surface-messages.ts removes variant: "h2" from the heading component, but tests/golden/surface-task-sync.json retains that property on the same heading component. The producer's own documentation states that the golden fixtures replay its exact bytes.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the stale heading variant from the golden fixture so that it matches the migrated producer.
